.name: Batch add to Steam collections
.note: Add games to specified writable collections. Supply appIds and an exact collection, or send per-game changes.
.parameters.collection: Exact name or ID of one writable collection for all these games.
.parameters.changes: Alternatively, supply the game AppID and a list of collection IDs for each game.
.description: Add games to specified writable collections. Supply appIds and an exact collection, or send per-game changes.
.error.badCollection: Specify writable collections using AppIDs and an exact collection name or ID, or supply collection IDs for each game.
.error.noCollection: No unique writable collection matched. Check the collection ID.
